title: patchwave timeline lanebook and release scribe (2026-08) - WIP
content:
Purpose
---
Living notes + operational checklist for the August patchwave. Goal: coordinate small batched fixes across serving-runtime, platform-engineering, and dedicated autoscale while preserving latency SLAs. This is intentionally loose — use as the single source-of-truth during the 72h window and capture decisions.

High-level summary
---
- Target window: 2026-08-12 03:00 UTC -> 2026-08-15 03:00 UTC (72h)
- Scope: security patch to networking stack, hotfix for KV cache leak, rollout of new batching heuristic (stage 1), minor console telemetry change
- Risk profile: medium (KV leak fix is high-value but touches hotspot code paths)

Operational rhythm (compact calendar)
---
- Day -7 (2026-08-05): Freeze merge for non-critical changes. Start smoke-test harness runs. Owner: Priya.
- Day -3 (2026-08-09): Canary images baked; perf bench ramp to 25% sim traffic. Owner: Samira.
- Day -1 (2026-08-11): Cut build, run end-to-end flows, update incident-runbook links. Owner: Jordan.
- Day 0 (2026-08-12): Begin patchwave. Stagger lanes A/B/C every 6h. Canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 30m hold between steps.
- Day +1 (2026-08-13): Focus on telemetry sampling and cost signals.
- Day +2 (2026-08-14): Roll forward console telemetry and finalize postmortem template.

Quick preflight checklist
---
- [ ] Confirm smoke test pass on blue and green images (smoke-id: smk-2026-08-09-1)
- [ ] Confirm canary runbook pinned to the right on-call rotation in PagerDuty
- [ ] Validate perf bench vs baseline (p95 token latency and p99 tail)
- [ ] Confirm KV cache metric alerts adjusted (+10% baseline) — SLO owner: Ethan
- [ ] Validate rollback artifacts: previous images, db migration revert steps
- [ ] Slack channel: #release-ops/patchwave-aug-2026 created and starred

Cutover lane cadence (detailed)
---
- LANE A (00:00 UTC start): control-plane-only services, no model-serving change. 1h hold.
- LANE B (+6h): serving-runtime + KV leak fix on non-critical shards. smoke curl, quick perf. 2h hold.
- LANE C (+12h): batching heuristic opt-in on 10% traffic; monitor throughput and p95. 3h hold.
- Escalation: if p99 increases >30% from baseline for >10m, pause and rollback lane.

Annotated release notes (draft)
---
Patchwave August 2026 (partial rollout)
- Fix: KV cache memory leak mitigation in serving-runtime (pr: #612). Expected to reduce memory pressure on long-lived sessions; rolling enablement across shards. Known impact: small GC bump during warmup.
- Feature: experimental batching heuristic (opt-in) to improve throughput at small seq lengths. Default OFF for now; will be evaluated via canary.
- Ops: networking library upgrade (libnet v2.3.1) to address TLS renegotiation hole. No customer-facing changes expected.
- Telemetry: additional token-level traces for console routes (sampled 0.5%) to help track cost regressions.

Decision matrix (who decides what)
---
- Abort window: On-call SRE + Release lead (Jordan) + Eng PM (Priya). Immediate abort if >2% error rate for core generate routes for >15m.
- Roll forward: Release lead + Observability owner (Ethan). Requires p95 within 15% of baseline and error rate within 0.5%.
- Partial rollback of batching heuristic: Service owner + Release lead. Can be toggled via feature flag in under 3 minutes.

Hotlines and contacts
---
- Release lead: Jordan Kim (pager: +1-555-0108)
- SRE on-call: rotation in PagerDuty (team: eng-sre)
- Observability: Ethan Morales
- Release coordinator: Priya Iyer
- Slack: #release-ops and pinned thread named "patchwave-aug-2026"

Post-release capture (notes to self)
---
- Capture perf snapshots (before/after) and annotate metric deltas in Confluence page linked above.
- Run user-facing smoke (chat flows + embeddings batch) and collect sample responses for quality drift check.
- Draft short customer note if telemetry sampling shows regression in console latencies >20ms (owner: product-hosted-api).

Open questions / TODOs
---
- Do we need to extend canary hold windows for markets in APAC? (Priya to propose schedule)
- Verify that dedicated capacity autoscaler is exempted from batching heuristic until v2 of rollout. (Action: Samira)
- Finalize gating checklist for auto-rollback thresholds in the orchestration service (RE-4832)

Appendix: quick commands & links
---
- Bake image: gh workflow dispatch -> release-orchestra/ci -> tag: patchwave-aug-2026
- Canary run: k8s namespace: patchwave-canary-aug
- Perf harness: perf/redwood-harness -> scenario: small-req-1k
- Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RE/Patchwave+Postmortem+Template

Notes captured during planning sync (raw)
---
- "Prefer more holds early; err on the side of pausing than rushing" — Samira
- "If we see GC transient, call it out under known impact and track warmup curve" — Ethan
- "Make sure customer comms team is on standby but don't send anything unless user-facing" — Priya

END OF DOCUMENT
